verdict.rationale: License and public-code matching references are a fair question for an AI coding assistant, but the evidence pack never documents Cursor flagging suggestions that match public code or showing license information. The AI Code Tracking API records which code was AI-generated versus human-written; that is adjacent and does not identify matching public sources or licenses. Bugbot covers bugs, security and code quality, not license matching.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can see license and public-code matching references for AI-suggested code
